scope: Matched Mac dense-head control and US-source continuation, frozen before feature preparation or fitting
motivation: The frozen old ensemble detects 21/27 target-intent clips and triggers on 18/81 confusers in the full new training-only US cohort. Test whether adding all matched sources improves the frozen-backbone route without losing old validation generalization. No failed-clip selection.
feature_protocol: Use the unchanged prepare_head_features.worker recipe: original serialized 16k PCM, 38400-sample zero lead and 16000-sample tail; variant0 quiet, variant1 existing seeded RIR/gain/colored-noise rendering. No resampling, speed change, source trimming, source relabeling or new TTS.
keyword_reference: Original complete source sample count, not an acoustic phoneme boundary
training: Both arms clone the authenticated historical control plan and its seed728, 10000 steps, 2500/5000/7500/10000 checkpoints, batch32positive/48TTSnegative/48ambient, negative weight5, Adam1e-4 with original schedule. Same starting weights and original PTQ representatives. No mining, endpoint, loss or topology change. Original backbone and temporal member remain frozen.
only_arm_difference: Treatment adds the complete 216-row training feature directory, as one separate uniform source-engine group for both labels. This intentionally changes engine probabilities from five to six groups and resulting source draws; it is not a claim that remaining batch examples stay identical.
derive_before_fitting: Bind the new completed index/complete hashes into treatment extra_training_features; preserve all base-control recipe/runtime identities. Save both final plans before either arm fits. Run the current same trainer for both arms because the historical trainer source hash differs.
validation: Use only the unchanged existing validation data, original 19-threshold grid and continuous selection policy. Select each dense arm independently; combine each selected dense head only with original temporal step20000 using the original exact equal mean, then calibrate on the same original validation scores. Never select from the 108 source clips or old paired/long regression.
followup: A promising frozen original-validation result may proceed to the existing paired/English/Mandarin regression at its fixed threshold. Reject regression or quality failures without unused-development/final access or threshold rescue. No direct board rollout or Hi ESP parity claim.
limits: Three Piper presets are training-only, correlated by generator/pretraining and not new independent people. Existing complete-source provenance limitations are retained. This differs from the concurrently running GPU v46 in representation, source and recipe; not an architecture-only comparison. No microphone, speaker, firmware or production-board access.
